completion.grammar:
root ::= unknown | known
unknown ::= "{\"outcome\":\"unknown\",\"relations\":[]}"
known ::= "{\"outcome\":\"known\",\"relations\":[" relation-list "]}"
relation-list ::= relation | relation "," relation | relation "," relation "," relation | relation "," relation "," relation "," relation
relation ::= "{\"sentence_index\":" sentence ",\"subject_start\":" offset ",\"subject_end\":" offset ",\"predicate\":" predicate ",\"object_start\":" offset ",\"object_end\":" offset ",\"polarity\":" polarity "}"
sentence ::= "0" | nonzero digits
offset ::= "0" | nonzero digits
predicate ::= "\"precedes\"" | "\"starts before\"" | "\"ends before\"" | "\"occurs before\"" | "\"follows\"" | "\"starts after\"" | "\"ends after\"" | "\"occurs after\""
polarity ::= "\"positive\"" | "\"negative\""
nonzero ::= [1-9]
digits ::= [0-9]*
completion.prompt:
